findings.title: Edited attachment provenance can exclude imported product work from review
findings.reason: Resolved within the accepted declarative trust model: all attached diff-base decisions must equal x-delivery-base; receive/scope verify imported commit existence, ancestry and its origin/HEAD merge-base. Replayed bundled probes now reject paired-base and later-shadowing edits and nonexistent imported HEAD. Targeted tests also reject unrelated HEAD/missing origin/HEAD, preserve delivery scope across supported implement/review and ordinary main advances. Removing only attached while retaining attach-approved is rejected. Consistently removing both markers and changing plaintext checked counts are accepted Baton-wide declarative residuals, not a stronger authenticity claim.
x-evidence: node .context\compound-engineering\ce-review\attach-013\probe.mjs: paired-base mutation -> validation [], bundled receive code 0, scope files [].
Same probe: later-shadowing diff-base -> validation [], bundled receive code 0, scope files [].
Same probe: x-imported-head = 40 hexadecimal a characters -> validation [], bundled receive code 0.
The added tamper test only uses malformed SHA strings or a mismatched single decision; it does not cover coordinated valid-SHA mutations.
The claimed permanent provenance can also be removed after phase_completed becomes implement: the attachment validation branch no longer runs and validation succeeds.

findings.title: Initial attachment accepts a hand-forged approval without a fresh human action
findings.reason: Resolved: hand-setting only gate role/date on never-approved output now fails E_TRANSITION in validate, bundled receive and scope. approve records one source/imported-head-bound attach-approved human-role decision; validator requires matching updated_by, hashes and date. Targeted stale/hash/actor/backdate/duplicate tests and supported refresh/reapproval pass. No invented phase-none receipt or cryptographic authenticity claim.
x-evidence: Probe first verifies never-approved receive exits 3 with E_GATE_PENDING.
Probe restores the never-approved snapshot and writes only the configured role and old date; validation [], bundled receive code 0.
No prior human approval, approve CLI call for that snapshot, imported receipt, or human updated_by was present.
Existing role vocabulary validation is correct syntactically, but cannot establish the fresh action required by this newly introduced attachment path.

findings.title: Schema reference still documents the reverted history-start invariant
findings.reason: Lines 34-37 still say feature histories shorter than 20 entries must start at specify (or have attachment provenance). Commit 4022803 deliberately removes that rule; src/lib/handoff.mjs imposes no start requirement, the restored legacy implement-only fixture validates, and both new compatibility tests pass. This contradicts docs/04-handoffs.md and the accepted compatibility/trust boundary. Remove the reverted start/retention claims and state that only initial phase-none or presence of attached/attach-approved requires attachment provenance. No product change is requested.
x-evidence: docs/reference/schemas.md:35-37 still claims the removed history-start invariant.
test/unit/validate-handoff.test.mjs:54 regression passes for existing implement-only history with no attachment.
test/integration/handoff-attach.test.mjs final compatibility test passes for 19- and 20-entry histories without origin markers.
